title: Different Singular Limits in a Gene Regulatory Network with Multiple Small Parameters
summary: We consider a planar ODE system from an important class of models for gene regulatory dynamics. The system depends singularly on the steepness parameters $0<\varepsilon_1,\varepsilon_2 \ll 1$ and converges to a piecewise-smooth system as these parameters tend to zero. Unlike previous studies, we do not assume that $\varepsilon_1 = \varepsilon_2$. As a consequence, the dynamics when $(\varepsilon_1, \varepsilon_2) \to (0,0)$ depends upon how the limit is taken.
